outcome: Instrument one critical digital journey and measure incident diagnosis time, latency and telemetry cost.
overview: Give operations teams a shared view of a customer journey, supporting services and selected AI calls. The pilot connects technical incidents to failed orders, delayed delivery estimates or slow responses. A repeatable measurement pack lets the customer compare diagnosis time and latency before a larger rollout.
kpi: median diagnosis time for seeded incidents, p95 transaction latency, telemetry spend per monitored service
scope: Planning estimate: three to four weeks after access approval. Week one captures baseline and instruments the chosen services. Week two builds dashboards and alerts. Week three runs seeded incidents and records measurements. Use a fourth week only for agreed remediation. Deliver configuration, service maps, budget settings, test evidence and an operational runbook.

prerequisites: Agreed access for the service team
A current inventory of what is covered
